title: Giza-wide model presented at the Malta conference
summary: Jeffrey tells of Giza-wide model presented at the Malta conference, about 2024 at Egypt (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Here is the model that they presented at the end of the Malta conference showing the entire Giza plateau and these underground vertical features connected into these cube features.

plain: A researcher called Jeffrey, on Jesse Michels's podcast, describes a model shown at the end of a conference in Malta in 2024 by a team including a man named Filippo. According to Jeffrey, the model covers the whole Giza Plateau in Egypt, including the Menkaure pyramid and the Sphinx. He says it shows vertical structures underground that connect to cube-shaped features, which if true would point to a large hidden network beneath the pyramids.
